caption:
Princess Purse charms using stickers and resin. This would be a fun party craft if you do a bit of prep beforehand to make the charms. Let me know if you need the links for everything I used. 🔗 
.
Here how to make them:
✨use silicon molds and stickers. Make sure the mold has holes in the top of it so you can turn these into charms later. 
✨place the sticker face down in the mold. 
✨mix your resin and add it into the mold. You can use sparkles on top as well. Just be careful they don’t blend and go on top of the sticker or you won’t see the princess when it dries. Tip: As the resin gets poured use your tweezers to make sure the sticker is still at the bottom. Press it down using the tweezers if it isn’t. 
✨Let it dry for 24 hours, then pop the out of the mold
✨add a jump ring and use B7000 glue to stick rhinestones around the resin. 
✨then add them to the chain or keychain once the rhinestones are dry. 
.
